name: clear_table_measure_string
description: Zeroes a 100-word global table, then measures the length of a zero-terminated string at the address register, capped at 40, and calls itself that many times. Only the string pointer and the table are read or written.

name: or_glyph_into_bitmap
description: Folds a lowercase letter to uppercase, indexes a five-byte-per-character font table starting at the space character, and ORs four glyph bytes into a bitmap with a 40-byte row stride.

name: stub_infinite_empty_loop
description: Contains only an empty infinite loop with no operations, so it does nothing except hang if entered.

name: halt_processor_on_blit_size
description: Executes only the halt instruction in a loop, so reaching it stops the processor; the blitter size register is listed as touched but no store appears in the code.

name: halt_processor_blitter_entry
description: Executes only the halt instruction in a loop, so reaching it stops the processor; the blitter size register is listed as touched but no store appears in the code.

name: noop_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately, so it has no effect.

name: save_condition_codes_to_global
description: Packs the five processor condition flags into the low bits of a global word and stores it. Seventeen unnamed routines reference it, so it serves as a flag save point.

name: noop_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately, so it has no effect.

name: run_six_stage_sequence
description: Saves registers into a stack frame, issues one system service trap, then calls a helper six times with preset arguments; a global flag selects between two argument setups, one of which derives values from two lookup tables.

name: run_six_blitter_steps
description: Calls a helper six times in both branches, with the zero-flag branch first initialising a global value from two lookup tables. Blitter registers are listed as touched through the helper calls.

name: noop_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately, so it has no effect.

name: stub_unreached_gap_bytes
description: Decoded from bytes that execution never reaches, and its body only returns uninitialised register values, so it has no real behaviour.

name: mirror_row_bytes_through_table
description: Walks each row of bytes from both ends, swapping each pair while translating every byte through a 256-entry lookup table, and repeats for a count read from a second table.

name: swap_row_block_words
description: Exchanges 16-bit words between the top and bottom halves of a block of rows, row by row, which reverses the block vertically; the row count comes from a second table.

name: program_blitter_four_planes
description: Computes a row offset and blitter control words from its inputs, then calls a helper at four plane offsets; one of two branches uses a different blitter modulo and control value.

name: return_registers_unchanged
description: Returns its two register arguments unchanged, so it is an identity pass-through with no effect.

name: store_args_clear_state
description: Stores its two arguments into global variables, then clears three further globals to zero, acting as a state initialiser.

name: decompress_lz_stream_window
description: Decodes a compressed byte stream in which literal runs are copied and back-references copy earlier output from a 1024-byte sliding window, with lengths taken from the token. Progress is kept in globals, and it returns when the input or output limit is reached.

name: unpack_literal_and_backref_block
description: Expands a packed buffer where a high-bit token copies a literal run and otherwise a 10-bit back-reference copies earlier output, until the requested output count is reached. It returns the number of bytes produced.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to a single invalid-instruction marker with no logic, so it is a stub and not a working routine.

name: run_init_steps_clear_flag
description: Calls a helper once with the argument one and twice with no argument, then clears a shared flag to zero. Ten unnamed routines call it.

name: check_four_helper_results
description: Returns zero only when the shared flag is clear and four helper calls with arguments zero to three all return zero; otherwise it returns one.

name: store_shared_mode_flag
description: Copies its argument into a shared global variable, which other routines test as a mode flag.

name: update_minimum_index_by_table
description: Replaces the stored index with its argument when no index is stored or when the table entry for the argument is not larger than the entry for the stored index, keeping a running minimum over a byte table.

name: commit_pending_index_and_reset
description: When a pending index is set, records it as the selected index if none is chosen or the table allows it, calls a helper with it, and then resets the pending index to minus one.

name: play_note_on_sound_channel
description: Maps a note number to a period from a lookup table and sets a sound channel's period and type from that entry. Out-of-range period or type values are reported through bad sound period and bad sound type messages.

name: step_channel_three_phase_sequence
description: On each call for the active channel it issues one of three helper commands in turn, advancing from the first phase to the second and then to the third, where it stays.

name: configure_playback_parameters
description: Passes a set of configuration values to a helper, then a floating-point constant, reads a value back and passes it on, and finishes with a further helper call.

name: parse_midi_header_and_tracks
description: Parses a Standard MIDI File header, checking the format, track count and time division, and reports errors for a bad or missing header. It then builds a table of track positions and lengths from the track chunks.

name: advance_midi_track_delays
description: Subtracts the elapsed time from every track's pending delay, dispatches events on tracks whose delay has reached zero, and passes the smallest remaining nonzero delay, scaled by a fixed-point ratio, to a helper.

name: read_track_delta_or_end
description: Reads the next variable-length delay for a track that still has data. A read position past the track end is reported as an ill-formed delay, and a track that has reached its end is marked finished.

name: parse_midi_event_and_dispatch
description: Reads one MIDI event with running-status support, handling system-exclusive, meta and channel messages. Tempo meta events combine three data bytes into one value, and unknown or malformed events are reported.

name: init_tick_ratio_constants
description: Stores its argument in a global, then loads double-precision constants and derives a ratio into a global that the tick scaling routine uses.

name: read_variable_length_value
description: Reads a MIDI variable-length value built from seven-bit groups, where a set high bit means more bytes follow, and advances the read pointer past them.

name: read_byte_advance_pointer
description: Reads one byte at the position the pointer refers to, advances the pointer by one, and returns the byte.

name: read_big_endian_word
description: Reads two bytes in big-endian order, advances the pointer by two, and returns the combined 16-bit value.

name: read_big_endian_longword
description: Reads four bytes in big-endian order, advances the pointer by four, and returns the combined 32-bit value.

name: reset_eighteen_table_records
description: Calls a helper for each of eighteen consecutive 48-byte entries in a global table, then calls a second helper once.

name: clear_four_strided_slots
description: Writes zero to four entries of a global table spaced 80 bytes apart.

name: recentre_twelve_bytes_into_block
description: Reads twelve byte values through a helper, subtracts 128 from each to centre it around zero, and records the largest positive and most negative. It then calls helpers per value and stores twelve result bytes in the output block.

name: start_voice_in_free_slot
description: Assigns a free voice slot for a sound. It first releases any slot already holding the same channel in its release stage, then fills the chosen slot with channel, volume and instrument values from tables, sets up its envelope fields, starts it through a helper, and marks it active.

name: release_voice_matching_channel
description: Finds the active voice slot that matches a channel and a second key. If that voice's instrument has no release stage the slot is cleared and a helper is called, otherwise the slot switches to its release stage.

name: store_word_by_index
description: Stores its second argument into a global four-byte table entry chosen by the first argument.

name: update_four_voice_envelopes
description: Steps each of four active voices once: decrements its timer and reverses its direction when the timer expires, adds the current level to four per-voice control bytes clamped to the signed byte range, and moves to the next envelope segment when the timer passes its breakpoint. Voices that finish their last stage are cleared and released through a helper.

name: compute_slide_level
description: Moves a current value toward its target by a proportional step based on elapsed time and the remaining difference, stores the new value, and returns a level scaled by a volume and capped at 64.

name: return_global_block_address
description: Returns the address of a shared global data block without changing anything.

name: run_state_machine_setup
description: Runs a fixed sequence of setup calls that pass handler numbers zero to twelve and fixed reference values, then loops a six-state machine that dispatches each state to a helper until the terminal state is reached.

name: step_state_machine_pass
description: Runs one pass of a six-state machine, calling a helper for the current state and storing the next state through a pointer. The pass returns once the terminal state is reached.

name: step_frame_generator_state
description: Runs one state step of a six-state machine like its neighbours; the routine's text references a bad frame generator message.

name: increment_counter_send_code
description: Increments a shared counter and passes a fixed negative code to a helper.

name: forward_to_helper_zero_four
description: Calls a helper with the arguments zero and four and returns.

name: forward_to_helper_four
description: Calls a helper with the argument four and returns.

name: delegate_single_helper_call
description: Calls one helper with no arguments and returns.

name: poll_with_bounded_retries
description: Repeatedly calls a checking helper; while it reports nothing it waits in steps of up to sixteen units against the remaining count, returning minus one when the count runs out.

name: scan_row_positions_for_result
description: Calls a helper with a small record for successive horizontal positions every two units, from zero up to 320 units, and returns the first non-negative result or minus one.

name: send_command_wait_for_status
description: Sends a command through a helper, then repeatedly checks a status helper until its result is not minus one, returning minus one at once if the first check fails. The command is then sent again and the result returned.

name: call_helper_sequence_four
description: Calls four helpers in order, one of them with the arguments four and zero, and returns with no result.

name: send_fixed_command_then_helper
description: Passes a fixed three-argument command to a helper and then calls a second helper. It is reached only as unreached code in the disk image.

name: assign_fourteen_unique_codes
description: Returns one when a global is clear. Otherwise it fills fourteen entries with distinct candidate codes, using two marker tables to skip values already used, and returns three.

name: run_scripted_setup_sequence
description: Runs a long fixed script of helper calls with constant arguments, checking each step's result and returning early unless it is minus one or minus three. Several steps pass floating-point constants, and it configures several table entries in turn.

name: run_timed_insert_queue_sequence
description: Makes several helper calls with fixed constants and two timed waits, with the arguments 15000 and 4000, then searches a six-entry table of 34-byte records for the insertion point of a new record and writes it into a free slot. It returns early on any status other than minus one or minus three.

name: insert_queue_record_after_setup
description: Makes several helper calls with fixed constants and two timed waits, then searches a six-entry table of 34-byte records for the insertion point of a new record and writes it into a free slot. It returns early on any status other than minus one or minus three.

name: wait_then_insert_queue_record
description: Starts with a timed wait of 15000, then runs the same helper sequence and a wait of 4000, and searches a six-entry table of 34-byte records to insert a new record into a free slot.

name: insert_queue_record_after_pause
description: Makes a few helper calls and a timed wait of 4000, then searches the six-entry table of 34-byte records for the insertion point and writes the new record into a free slot. It returns early on any status other than minus one or minus three.

name: insert_queue_record_after_wait
description: Makes a helper call and a timed wait of 4000, then inserts a new record into the six-entry table of 34-byte records by finding its position and shifting later entries down. It then polls a helper until it reports a result and clears a state global when done.

name: insert_queue_record_no_wait
description: Searches the six-entry table of 34-byte records for the insertion point of a new record, shifts later records down when a slot is free, writes the record with the current counter, and then polls a helper until it reports a result.

name: insert_queue_record_by_key
description: Scans the six-entry table of 34-byte records from a starting entry, comparing two key values, then shifts later records down, writes the new record, and runs the standard helper sequence.

name: insert_queue_record_by_offset
description: Scans the six-entry table of 34-byte records from a given offset, comparing against two key values, then inserts the new record into the free slot it finds, shifting later records down.

name: insert_queue_record_at_index
description: Shifts later records down by one slot from a fixed index in the six-entry table of 34-byte records, writes the new record at that index with the current counter, and runs the standard helper sequence with a wait of 2000.

name: shift_record_block_then_insert
description: Repeatedly calls a helper to move a block of records one step at a time, then writes the new record at the given index in the six-entry table and runs the standard helper sequence.

name: send_queue_record_then_wait
description: Sends a queue record through a helper with a fixed size, issues several command helpers, then waits 2000. If the status is clear it moves on to a closing helper check and clears a state global when done.

name: run_status_poll_then_clear
description: Issues a helper command and checks its status. If the status is not clear it polls a status helper until it finishes, and then clears a state global.

name: poll_status_until_done
description: Polls a status helper, returning any value other than minus one or zero early, then sends a final helper call and clears a state global.

name: match_status_codes_then_clear
description: Reads a status helper repeatedly until its value matches one expected code or is zero, returning other non-matching values. It then issues a helper call and clears a state global when the status is minus one or minus three.

name: poll_status_until_expected
description: Polls a status helper until its value matches an expected code, returning any value that matches neither the expected nor the alternate code. On finishing it issues a helper call and clears a state global.

name: clear_state_return_zero
description: Sets a shared global to zero and returns zero.

name: format_entries_as_minutes_seconds
description: Loops over the active entries in the six-slot record table and passes each entry's value, divided by twelve, to a formatting helper that writes minutes and seconds text in the minutes colon two-digit seconds style.

name: draw_shifted_point_pair
description: Adds one to both coordinates of two points that define a rectangle, then passes the shifted points and the original points to a helper in two different modes.

name: run_screen_with_callback
description: Sets up a screen with a series of helper draw and reset calls, selects one of two prompt texts from the first argument, then runs the supplied callback and cleans up. It returns the callback result, with minus three mapped to minus one.

name: run_fixed_command_script
description: Issues a fixed sequence of helper commands with small codes, including timed waits, checks each status, and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_via_callback
description: Runs the same fixed command sequence as its neighbours, but sends each command through a callback held in a register, and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_wait
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at its timed-wait step, then continues through the remaining commands and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_loop_entry
description: Polls a status helper while it reports zero, then continues the same fixed command sequence through a callback and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_four
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at its fourth step, polls a status helper, and then continues through the remaining commands, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_match_entry
description: Checks a status helper against an expected value, then runs the remaining commands of the fixed sequence through a callback, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_tail
description: Starts the fixed command sequence part way through, at its command for a later step, and runs the remaining commands through a callback, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_six
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at a command with code six, issues the rest of the sequence through a callback, and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_four_pair
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at its fourth-step pair of commands and continues through the callback-driven steps, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_twelve
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at the callback step for code twelve, then runs the remaining steps, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_thirty
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at the step with code thirty, then runs the remaining steps through a callback, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_nine
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at its plain command step, then runs the rest through a callback, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_ramp
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at a step that sets a double-precision ramp value, then runs the rest through a callback and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_ninety
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at the step for code ninety-nine, then runs the rest through a callback and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_state_init
description: Initialises three state globals, then polls a callback until it reports a result, and runs the remaining steps of the fixed sequence, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_poll_wait
description: Polls a status helper until it reports zero, then continues the fixed command sequence with a timed step and a callback, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_thirty_four
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at its thirty-four step, issues the next commands through a callback, and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_state_two
description: Sets a state global to two, issues the next command through a callback, and runs the remaining steps, returning the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_command_script_from_step_seventy_one
description: Starts the fixed command sequence at its seventy-one step, issues the next command through a callback, and returns minus one or the callback result.

name: forward_script_result
description: Calls one routine and returns its result unchanged, acting as a shared entry point that nineteen unnamed routines call.

name: run_second_command_script
description: Runs a second fixed command sequence that begins with a setup call and sets a flag, including a conditional step. It returns the first result that is not minus one, and on its final path it polls a status helper until zero and returns minus one.

name: run_second_script_from_step_five
description: Starts the second command sequence at its step with code five, issues the following commands through a callback, and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_second_script_from_step_two
description: Starts the second command sequence at its step with code two, then runs the following commands through a callback, polling a status helper on the final path before returning minus one.

name: run_second_script_from_step_twenty_seven
description: Starts the second command sequence at its twenty-seven step, runs the following commands, and returns the first result that is not minus one, with a polling path on the final step.

name: run_second_script_from_step_nine
description: Starts the second command sequence at its step with code nine, issues the following commands, and returns the first result that is not minus one.

name: run_second_script_from_step_sixty_five
description: Starts the second command sequence at its sixty-five step, issues the next command, and polls a status helper on the final path before returning minus one.

name: wait_for_status_then_cancel
description: Calls a helper and, if it reports minus one or minus three, polls a status helper until it reads zero and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns the helper result.

name: poll_until_zero_then_fail
description: Polls a helper until it returns zero, then returns minus one.

name: poll_until_zero_then_fail
description: Polls a helper until it returns zero, then returns minus one.

name: poll_status_with_cleanup
description: Clears the state with a helper call, then loops over two status helper calls, issuing a closing helper call when a result arrives and returning minus one when the loop ends.

name: poll_until_value_differs
description: Polls a helper while it returns zero. When it returns a value different from the expected code it runs a closing helper and returns that value, otherwise it returns minus one.

name: poll_until_value_changes
description: Polls a helper that must return zero, then polls a second helper until its value differs from the expected code, issues a closing helper call, and returns that value. A nonzero first result returns minus one.

name: poll_until_value_differs
description: Polls a helper while it returns zero. When it returns a value different from the expected code it runs a closing helper and returns that value, otherwise it returns minus one.

name: noop_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately, so it has no effect.

name: poll_status_with_cleanup
description: Clears the state with a helper call, then loops over two status helper calls, issuing a closing helper call when a result arrives and returning minus one when the loop ends.

name: poll_until_value_differs
description: Polls a helper while it returns zero. When it returns a value different from the expected code it runs a closing helper and returns that value, otherwise it returns minus one.

name: poll_until_value_changes
description: Polls a helper that must return zero, then polls a second helper until its value differs from the expected code, issues a closing helper call, and returns that value. A nonzero first result returns minus one.

name: poll_until_value_differs
description: Polls a helper while it returns zero. When it returns a value different from the expected code it runs a closing helper and returns that value, otherwise it returns minus one.

name: noop_return_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately, so it has no effect.

name: run_timed_step_loop
description: Runs a per-step loop for the requested count. Each pass optionally sends a pair of helper calls depending on the parity of a global, decrements a countdown global, and checks a status helper. It returns minus one when the count is zero.

name: run_timed_step_loop_indirect
description: Repeats the same per-step loop as its neighbour, but reads its parity value, countdown and status through pointers, and stops when the status helper reports a result.

name: run_timed_step_loop_entry
description: Enters the per-step loop with the parity taken from a register, runs the same helper steps, and returns the status helper result when it reports one.

name: stop_with_status_minus_three
description: Issues two helper calls and returns minus three.

name: run_timed_step_loop_counted
description: Runs the per-step loop for a count held in a register, returning minus one when the count is zero and otherwise the status helper result.

name: call_helper_if_flag_set
description: Calls a helper and, when a shared flag is nonzero, calls two more helpers.

name: call_helper_if_flag_set
description: Calls a helper and, when a shared flag is nonzero, calls two more helpers.

name: run_flagged_helper_sequence
description: Makes helper calls in order, and when a shared flag is nonzero it makes extra helper calls and sets a global to thirty, then issues a sequence of helper calls with fixed arguments.

name: run_stack_param_call_sequence
description: Issues a series of helper calls that fill a small stack parameter block with fixed values, adding a second set of values when a shared flag is nonzero.

name: register_shapeset_slot
description: Records a shapeset pointer in a per-index table. If the slot already holds a value it first reports that the shapeset is already loaded.

name: release_shapeset_slot
description: Clears the shapeset slot for an index, passing the stored value to a helper first if the slot was in use.

name: classify_code_into_group
description: When the first value is one of two fixed identifiers, it places the second value into one of several numeric ranges and derives two group codes from the range before calling helpers. Values outside the ranges are ignored.

name: send_sixteen_fixed_entries
description: Passes sixteen fixed reference values to a helper in order, one call for each, and returns.

name: send_six_fixed_entries
description: Passes six fixed reference values to a helper in order, one call for each, and returns.

name: dispatch_thirty_entries_by_class
description: Loops over thirty entries and, for codes in a few fixed ranges, passes the entry index and a shared value to a helper.

name: dispatch_entry_code_fragment
description: Unreached fragment of the entry dispatcher. It routes codes in a small range to a helper call with the entry index.

name: dispatch_entries_from_code_thirty
description: Unreached fragment of the entry dispatcher that enters its loop at the code thirty step, passing the entry index to a helper and continuing through the remaining entries.

name: dispatch_entries_with_restart
description: Unreached variant of the entry dispatcher. It passes a shared value and each entry index to a helper for codes in several ranges, restarting its loop on code thirty.

name: dispatch_entries_after_prefix
description: Unreached variant of the entry dispatcher that first passes a shared value to a helper, then routes entries by code range.

name: dispatch_entries_from_prefix_step
description: Unreached variant of the entry dispatcher that first passes a shared value to a helper, then routes each entry by its code range.

name: place_items_in_two_runs
description: Places items spaced eight units apart in two runs, one from the given index to the end and one from the start up to that index, each drawn through a helper call at a fixed vertical offset.

name: place_column_items_spaced
description: Passes entries to a helper in a loop, then places a column of items at offsets starting at six and stepping by eight, through helper calls with fixed arguments.

name: place_entries_with_stride_eight
description: Passes each entry to a helper with an offset that grows by eight per entry, then issues a closing helper call.

name: place_items_descending_by_eight
description: Does nothing when a mode global holds one of two excluded values or a second global is not in the expected state. Otherwise it places items spaced eight units apart in two runs, moving leftward from a fixed starting position.

name: place_items_descending_two_runs
description: Places items spaced eight units apart moving leftward, in two runs from a starting index, each drawn through a helper call at a fixed vertical offset.

name: place_items_descending_loop_entry
description: Places items spaced eight units apart moving leftward in a loop, starting from a pointer-held base, then places a further run of items and issues a closing helper call.

name: place_items_descending_tail
description: Places a run of items spaced eight units apart moving leftward, then places a second run and issues a closing helper call.

name: advance_counter_capped_at_ten
description: Increments a shared counter up to a cap of ten, then calls a helper.

name: increment_pointed_value_and_notify
description: Increments the integer at the address held in a register and calls a helper.

name: clear_global_counter
description: Sets a shared global to zero.

name: send_mode_parameters_when_set
description: When a shared global is nonzero it pushes it onto a small stack parameter block and calls a helper. When the global is one and a second global is not fifteen it sends a pair of values chosen by parity, then sends the global again.

name: send_mode_parameters_by_parity
description: Sends a fixed record through a helper, then sends the shared global when it is nonzero, and when it equals one sends a parity-selected pair of values.

name: forward_to_helper_zero_one
description: Calls a helper with the arguments zero and one and returns.

name: set_flag_if_global_zero
description: Sets a shared global to one when it is zero and to zero otherwise.

name: init_three_globals_then_notify
description: Sets three shared globals to fixed values, calls a helper, then calls a helper with the argument thirty-nine.

name: fill_grid_with_non_repeating_picks
description: Fills three blocks of four rows of eleven bytes each with values chosen by a helper, avoiding the same value twice in a row, then issues a closing helper call. It is unreached code in the disk image.

name: save_game_state_to_disk
description: Writes a sixteen-byte game state block through a file service call, retrying through a helper until it succeeds, then reports whether the game was saved or could not be saved.

name: load_game_state_from_disk
description: Reads a sixteen-byte game state block through a file service call, retrying through a helper until it succeeds. It restores the saved values, or reports that no saved game was found.

name: confirm_and_erase_hiscores
description: Shows the empty-table message when the hiscore table is empty. Otherwise it asks whether to erase the table and clears it when the answer is yes.

name: save_hiscore_table_to_disk
description: Writes the 208-byte hiscore table through a file service call, retrying through a helper until the write succeeds.

name: load_hiscore_table_from_disk
description: Zeroes a shared global, then reads the 208-byte hiscore table from disk through a file service call.

name: render_status_buffer_when_mode
description: When a mode global equals fifteen, it fills a 140-byte message buffer through a helper using shared values, either as a status display or after resetting two counters, and then sends it.

name: format_page_line_word_text
description: Builds a 140-byte text buffer through a helper using the shared page, line and word values when its argument is zero. Otherwise it resets two counters and builds the buffer, then sends it.

name: show_potion_match_prompt
description: Builds a message buffer from shared values and sends it through a helper, then sends it again through a second helper. The text it references is the drink-potion matching prompt.

name: draw_panel_wait_for_key
description: Draws a bordered panel with two helper draw calls, then waits for a key through a helper and returns the first nonzero character it reads.

name: is_yes_answer
description: Returns one when the character is a y in either case, and zero otherwise.

name: step_counter_and_draw_range
description: Clamps a shared counter to the range zero to nine, then loops over a small grid of cell pairs and passes each pair to a helper.

name: increment_counter_and_draw_grid
description: Increments a shared counter, computes loop bounds from it and from a pointed value, then calls a helper for each cell in the range.

name: step_pointer_and_walk_grid
description: Unreached grid walk. It moves a pointed counter toward zero, visits cells between computed row and column bounds, passing each cell's coordinates and a flag to a helper and the result to a second helper.

name: walk_grid_cells_decrement
description: Unreached grid walk that decrements a pointed counter and visits each cell in computed bounds, passing the coordinates and a flag to a helper and its result to a second helper.

name: walk_grid_cells_bounded
description: Unreached grid walk that visits each cell between computed row and column bounds, passing the coordinates and a flag to a helper and its result to a second helper. It copies a bound into a shared global when that global is zero.

name: walk_grid_cells_from_row
description: Unreached grid walk that starts at a computed column and visits each cell up to a row limit, passing the coordinates and a flag to a helper and its result to a second helper.

name: walk_grid_cells_by_bounds
description: Unreached grid walk that visits cells between row and column bounds, passing each cell's coordinates and a flag to a helper and its result to a second helper.

name: walk_grid_cells_from_column
description: Unreached grid walk that visits cells between row and column bounds, starting from a computed column, and passes each cell to a helper and its result to a second helper.

name: walk_grid_rows_to_limit
description: Unreached grid walk that visits each row up to a limit and each column in range, passing each cell to a helper and its result to a second helper.

name: walk_grid_cells_row_wrap
description: Unreached grid walk that visits cells row by row, wrapping the column back to a start value at each row end, and passes each cell to a helper and its result to a second helper.

name: walk_filtered_grid_rows
description: Visits a range of rows and passes each cell to a helper, but only for mode codes in fixed ranges. For any other code it returns without doing anything.

name: walk_filtered_grid_columns
description: Visits a range of columns and passes each cell to a helper, but only for mode codes in fixed ranges. For other codes it returns without doing anything.

name: walk_grid_rows_when_mode_matches
description: Visits a range of rows and passes each cell to a helper when the mode code is one of several fixed values, otherwise it returns without doing anything.

name: walk_grid_rows_descending
description: Visits rows from a limit down to a start value, passing each cell's coordinates and a flag to a helper and its result to a second helper.

name: walk_grid_rows_flagged
description: Visits rows in descending order, passing each cell to a helper and its result to a second helper, with the first helper call made only when a flag argument is set.

name: handle_enter_key_in_list
description: Reads a key through a helper and, when it is the carriage-return key and the list index is valid, moves the entry to the next larger value and calls a helper. It does nothing when the index is minus one.

name: advance_list_on_enter_key
description: Reads a key through a helper and, when it is the carriage-return key and the list index is valid, moves the entry to the next larger value and calls a helper.

name: initialise_selection_state
description: Clears and sets shared globals, calls a helper with the argument forty-five, then calls helpers with the current selection values.

name: derive_code_from_table_lookup
description: Looks up a byte in a table indexed by a shared global, combines it with a helper result through arithmetic and bitwise inversion, and stores the result back in the shared global.

name: advance_index_wrapping_nine
description: Calls a helper with the argument 255 to pick a starting index, then returns that index advanced by one within the range zero to eight, wrapping back to zero after eight.

name: increment_index_wrapping_nine
description: Returns its index advanced by one, wrapping back to zero once it passes eight.

name: store_byte_in_table_slot
description: Stores a byte in a thirty-slot table. Negative indices are counted back from the end of the table and non-negative indices from the start, and indices of thirty or more are ignored. It is unreached code in the disk image.

name: store_byte_in_table_unbounded
description: Stores a byte in the same thirty-slot table as its neighbour without a bounds check, counting negative indices back from the table end. It is unreached code in the disk image.

name: store_byte_at_table_offset
description: Stores a byte at a table position given by the index, without any bounds check.

name: store_byte_in_second_table_slot
description: Stores a byte in a second thirty-slot table. Negative indices are counted back from the end of the table and non-negative indices from the start, and indices of thirty or more are ignored.

name: store_byte_in_second_table_unbounded
description: Stores a byte in the second thirty-slot table without a bounds check, counting negative indices back from the table end.

name: store_byte_at_second_table_offset
description: Stores a byte at a position in the second table given by the index, without any bounds check.

name: store_byte_in_third_table_slot
description: Stores a byte in a third thirty-slot table for non-negative indices below thirty, ignoring other indices.

name: store_byte_in_third_table_unbounded
description: Stores a byte in the third table for a non-negative index without checking the upper bound. It is unreached code in the disk image.

name: update_slot_with_running_max
description: Stores a byte in a thirty-slot table for a valid index and updates a shared running maximum from the slot's previous value, then saves the new value in a parallel table.

name: update_slot_max_via_pointer
description: Stores a flag in a thirty-slot table and keeps the larger of a pointed value and the slot's previous value, writing the result back through the pointer.

name: copy_slot_value_via_pointer
description: Copies a slot's stored value into a pointed location, writes that value back to the slot, and sets the slot's flag byte.

name: fill_byte_then_notify
description: Stores a byte from a helper call at a position offset by a shared global, then calls a helper with the position and a flag. It is unreached code in the disk image.

name: mask_and_set_low_bits_then_notify
description: Clears the low five bits of a byte at a position given by a shared global, ORs in a helper value plus one, and calls a helper with the position and a flag.

name: store_masked_helper_value_then_notify
description: Stores the low five bits of a helper result in a table slot offset by a shared global, then calls a helper with the position and a flag. It is unreached code in the disk image.

name: append_record_or_store_slot
description: Stores three bytes in a shared block and passes them to a helper. When the helper reports minus one it appends the record while the count is below thirty, otherwise it stores the third byte in a slot; the routine's text references an overflow message.
